Name: NSFW Photos - Heart Album - Bachelors
Author: sweetinsanity9
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=4]This mod adds photos to the photo album mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43247][color=#ffff00]Heart Album[/color][/url]. Each heart/friendship level unlocks a new photo for each character which will be added to the album. [/size]

[size=3]This time around I'm doing the bachelors! Not everyone is done yet. [/size][/font][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53780/53780-1791771450-457841944.png[/img][/center]
[center][font=Georgia][size=4]Download the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43247][color=#00ff00]Heart Album[/color][/url] from here on Nexus.
Unzip my mod's folder and navigate to the folder[i] [color=#00ffff]Mods\HeartAlbum\assets[/color][/i]
Copy and paste the pngs from my mod's folder into this folder and you're done!
Press [color=#ff00ff]F8[/color] once in game to open the album and view your photos.[/size][/font][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53780/53780-1791768648-236519424.png[/img][/center]
